name: Alu Kangmet
ingredients: Spring onion or coriander leaves for garnish
instructions: 1. Boil the potatoes until soft, peel them, and set them aside to cool.
2. Dry roast the dry red chilies on a pan or over an open flame until they are dark and fragrant.
3. In a bowl, crush the roasted chilies with salt until they form a coarse powder.
4. Add the boiled potatoes to the chili mixture and mash them together using your hands or a potato masher.
5. Drizzle raw mustard oil over the mixture and incorporate well.
6. Garnish with chopped spring onions or coriander leaves and serve as a side dish with steamed rice.
description: Alu Kangmet is a quintessential Manipuri side dish that highlights the simplicity of North Eastern cuisine. It is a staple comfort food, often served alongside rice and lentil soup (dal), known for the pungent, authentic kick of mustard oil and roasted chilies.
